normative_extracts.quote: Temporal provides separate classes for date-only, time-only, zoned date-time, and exact instant values, all immutable and calendar-aware.

browser_support.notes: Use @js-temporal/polyfill or temporal-polyfill until Temporal reaches Baseline Newly Available.

pipeline_phases: Explicit Domain Type Selection (Instant vs PlainDate vs ZonedDateTime)
engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Temporal separates physical instants from wall-clock calendar dates and timezones, backed by immutable value objects and ICU4X timezone rules.

production_failures.symptom: Recurring calendar event shifts by 1 hour after Daylight Saving Time transition
production_failures.root_cause: Adding 86,400,000 ms to a legacy Date timestamp ignores DST 23-hour and 25-hour days.
production_failures.mitigation: Use Temporal.ZonedDateTime.add({ days: 1 }) so calendar arithmetic preserves the wall-clock hour across DST.

production_failures.symptom: User birthday displays as the previous day in US timezones
production_failures.root_cause: Parsing '1990-05-12' with new Date() creates UTC midnight, which shifts to May 11 when formatted in UTC-5.
production_failures.mitigation: Represent calendar-only dates with Temporal.PlainDate.from('1990-05-12') which has no timezone offset.
